_doc: Row 76 — release policy for the native Android build, checked on the REAL APK/AAB by tools/android-release-check-76.mjs in .github/workflows/native-client.yml. min_target_sdk follows Google Play (API 36 for new apps and updates since 2026-08-31). Raise it when Play raises the bar; never lower it. Row 165 (owner decision): REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES allowed — in-app update like the owner app (direct distribution). Row 175 (owner decision, no paid identity): UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHOUT_USER_ACTION allowed — Android 12+ installs the app's OWN update (same key) without the installer screen. Row 168 (owner decision): every Android version from 5.0 (API 21) — min_sdk 21, and a v1 (JAR) signature next to v2/v3 because Android 5.0-6.0 only verify v1.
